asset.name: UndoBanner
asset.description: The reversible-action surface explaining what changed, offering undo before it expires, reporting rollback progress, and handling the case where undo itself fails.

requires.reason: Reversal, grouping, and expiry belong to the shared history service.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

signatureMoment.description: A destructive action completes immediately with a visible, time-bounded way back, so the interface feels forgiving rather than interrogative.

rationale: Pairs with the undoable-destructive-action discipline: prefer reversible soft deletion with visible undo, and escalate to a confirmation dialog only where reversal is genuinely impossible.
